title: Kanye West Plays Porn For Adidas Executives [Watch]
htmlContent:
Recently Kanye West’s Twitter account and IG account has been locked after offensive tweet aimed at Jewish community on Saturday night.

Ye opened up in a ABC News Exclusive interview with Linsey Davis. He says social media is like “driving a car” “it’s all in how we use it” However the black billionaire refuse to stay out of news headlines.

The post was highly controversial and deemed Anti-Semitic and offended many in the Jewish community. Tweeter removed his post that violated company policy: "The funny thing is I can't be Anti Semitic because black people are Jew also. You guys have toyed with me and tried to blackball anyone who opposes your agenda," the rapper wrote in the now-deleted post.

On Monday DJ Akademiks shared a reel of a video leaked, a low budget 30-minute documentary titled Last Week, where his recent meetings and personal involvements are captured on film. He apparently shares a pornographic video with two Adidas executives who faces are blurred out in order to make a point about devotion.

Comparing one of the actor’s voices with an Adidas executive while they watched in alignment. It is unclear whether the meeting took place before or after Adidas’ announcement last week that its relationship with Yeezy was “under review,” which followed a list of controversies, including the debut of West’s politically provocative “White Lives Matter” shirts at Paris Fashion Week.

Ye, formally known as Kanye West, slammed Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg and declared his Instagram account deactivated.

West made the accusation right after 1:30 a.m. on Twitter on Saturday, where he also shared a supposed photo of himself and Zuckerberg.

"Look at this Mark. How you gone kick me off Instagram. You used to be my n----," West tweeted. At the time of writing, West's Instagram feed hasn't been updated for 14 hours.

Elon Musk, would reply with, "Welcome back to Twitter, my friend!"

Musk is in negotiations to buy Twitter.
